value.body: A brand associate supports a brand team in planning campaigns, launches, packaging and how a product is presented to customers. Employers include consumer goods companies, retail and consumer brands, and advertising or brand agencies. A typical day involves tracking sales and market data, coordinating with agencies and designers, and preparing briefs and reports.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BBA, B.Com or B.A.; many brand roles prefer an MBA in marketing

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Excel, PowerPoint, market research and sales dashboards

items.label: Indian FMCG market revenue
items.note: Industry estimate of the consumer-goods sector many brand teams work in

items.label: People employed in the FMCG sector
items.note: Sector-wide figure, not brand roles alone

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers often enter through internships or as marketing or sales trainees, then move into a brand team. Many brand management roles at consumer companies are filled from MBA campuses.

value.title: At a glance
items: Field sales experience is often part of the path in consumer goods companies.
Next roles: assistant brand manager, brand manager.
Without an MBA, agency or startup roles are a more common route.

value.title: BBA enrolment in regular mode
value.note: Regular mode only; all-modes enrolment in 2023-24 was higher (~8.8 lakh). Counts all BBA students, not only marketing specialisations.
